roles.name: Jailor
roles.resolution: A released prisoner gives no execution result. Jailor cannot execute on N1; on later nights, surviving an attempted execution differs from release or never being jailed.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Marshal
roles.resolution: Holding Tribunal gives no private result. A claimed Tribunal must match the public daytime trial sequence; a quiet night has no Marshal action to report.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Mayor
roles.resolution: Before Reveal, a quiet night supplies no role result. Typing a Mayor claim does not trigger the public reveal or extra votes.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Monarch
roles.resolution: A held, roleblocked or obstructed Knight is not a completed Knight. Check the next-day Knight announcement/status; an existing knight dying is separate feedback.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Prosecutor
roles.resolution: Holding Prosecute gives no ability result. A real prosecution has a public daytime resolution; it cannot be supplied by a private night claim.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Coroner
roles.resolution: Without an Autopsy, do not invent a killer comparison. An unblocked no-match is a result; an interrupted Examine is no result. Autopsy and Examine refer to different players. The role page says Enchant/Illusion do not change this result; Keywords conflicts on Illusion, so that interaction is not presented as settled.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Investigator
roles.resolution: No Crime is a completed investigation result, not silence. Roleblock, obstacle or suppressed feedback is no result. Murder means an attack that night, not necessarily a kill.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Lookout
roles.resolution: No visible visitors is a usable observation only after a completed Watch. Astral traffic is absent from the list; an interrupted or suppressed Watch is not an empty list.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Psychic
roles.resolution: Odd nights give Good pairs; even nights give Evil trios. No vision is not an all-good/all-evil group. Late-game failure-message triggers remain uncertain in the source.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Seer
roles.resolution: Friends or Enemies compares apparent factions, not exact roles. Both selected players must be recorded. An interrupted comparison supplies neither Friends nor Enemies.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Sheriff
roles.resolution: Innocent and Suspicious are actual results. Roleblock, obstacle or suppressed feedback is not Innocent; Innocent does not establish a Town role.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Spy
roles.resolution: A quiet Bug is not proof that the player is Town. Existing Bugs can keep reporting later visits; an interrupted new placement does not establish a new Bug.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Tracker
roles.resolution: No visible visit can mean staying home or astral activity. It is a successful observation only if Track resolved; a failed Track is not a stay-home result.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Bodyguard
roles.resolution: No interception reported is not a save. Self Protect stays home, has two uses and grants Basic Defense; it does not fight an attacker or Guard another player.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Cleric
roles.resolution: An unblocked quiet night normally gives no attack/save notice. A prevented Barrier is a failure, not a save. Quiet Self Barrier still spends its once-per-game use.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Crusader
roles.resolution: Separate target-attack feedback from your own visitor-attack feedback. A quiet Fortify is not a save, and a visitor attack is not proof that visitor died.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Oracle
roles.resolution: No attack feedback does not confirm that the selected role exists. Aegis Oracle is the once-per-game self-role choice; target roles, not player numbers, and do not repeat a role consecutively.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Trapper
roles.resolution: Build is preparation, not a visit or save. A quiet placed Trap can persist into later nights. A harmful trigger is not the same as a complete non-harmful visitor-role list.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Deputy
roles.resolution: A miss is private to the Deputy and spends the single shot. No public animation does not disprove a miss; a held shot is not a missed shot.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Trickster
roles.resolution: No absorption is not a save. Self Mirror has one use. An absorbed attack must be stored before Unleash; while stored, another ordinary Mirror placement is unavailable.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Veteran
roles.resolution: A quiet Alert still spends a charge. No Alert cannot produce Alert shots. You learn how many visitors you shot, not a complete named visitor list or guaranteed kill count.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Vigilante
roles.resolution: Load or hold nights are not shots. A surviving target is not automatically a missed visit; preserve defense/failure feedback and any Town-hit penalty separately.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Admirer
roles.resolution: A negative Admire is a result; a prevented Admire is not. Care protects you and the found Obsession, while Bestow is a separate daytime effect, not a marriage proposal.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Amnesiac
roles.resolution: No eligible role to Remember means no transformation yet. Remember is automatic; it is not a chosen night visit, an investigation, or a current public role announcement.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Retributionist
roles.resolution: A missing/contested corpse is a failure, not a negative investigation. You are roleblock-immune; the corpse ability and its destination still determine other restrictions and feedback.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Socialite
roles.resolution: No rejection reported does not prove no one visited. Guests and permitted bypasses can enter; a rejection notice does not name the rejected visitors. You are roleblock-immune.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Tavern Keeper
roles.resolution: A visit alone does not prove roleblock success. Immunity, Hungover, jail or an obstacle can change the account. You are roleblock-immune; an uncautious Serial Killer can retaliate.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Catalyst
roles.resolution: No visible second action does not alone prove failure: the recipient needs a compatible ability and correct cycle. Do not promise extra charges or a doubled effect for every role.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Pilgrim
roles.resolution: A quiet night is normal: there is no Pilgrim ability to succeed, fail or produce a result. Messages about attacks or interference come from other roles.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Archmage
roles.resolution: Retrain and the book attack are alternative modes. An interrupted Retrain does not establish a new role; check the ally’s changed role card rather than inventing investigative feedback.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Hex Master
roles.resolution: A quiet Hex is not a kill or a protective save. A failed visit is not a new Hex. The book’s astral attack and the final Hex Bomb are distinct from ordinary Hex placement.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Witch
roles.resolution: Use the controlled role’s actual feedback, including failures. A control/immunity notice alone does not prove the forced action succeeded; your observed visit is to the first target.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Conjurer
roles.resolution: Holding Meteor gives no daytime kill. A defended Meteor differs from a death and still has public evidence; a nighttime book attack is a separate action.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Ritualist
roles.resolution: A wrong role guess spends an attempt and gives no failure message. That silence is different from a correct-guess notice; it does not reveal the target’s actual role. A correct guess can still leave an Invincible target alive.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Jinx
roles.resolution: No visitor-attack feedback is not an empty named visitor list. Attack feedback without a Jinx death can leave a surviving witness who knows your identity.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Dreamweaver
roles.resolution: A selected target is not confirmed Insomnia. A qualifying Town visit on the following night can cure Dreamweave before Insomnia; prevention and later recovery are separate states.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Enchanter
roles.resolution: A quiet Enchant supplies no true-role reveal. Alterate only changes death information if the player dies while it applies; an unused-looking result does not justify inventing a death.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Illusionist
roles.resolution: Illusion changes appearances, not real abilities. A quiet night gives no new Town investigation; Phantasm and death Disguise are separate modes. Do not claim every investigator is fooled.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Medusa
roles.resolution: Stone is a persistent mark, not a kill/save result. Holding makes no ordinary Stone visit. During Grace Period N1, a visible Stone visit cannot support an unavailable TP visit.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Necromancer
roles.resolution: An unusable or contested corpse is not a successful result. You are roleblock-immune, but corpse availability, ability restrictions and destination failures still matter.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Poisoner
roles.resolution: No Smog rejection reported is not proof of an empty house. Drink is a separate roleblock mode. You are roleblock-immune; Smog and a book attack cannot be used together.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Potion Master
roles.resolution: A quiet Heal is not save feedback. Self Heal uses the same protection mode, cannot be used in a 1v1, and is not a visit to another player. Reveal is a role result, not a visitor list.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Voodoo Master
roles.resolution: Silence, Deafen and Blind suppress different things. No victim report does not establish failure. Sources disagree on a Blind notice, so no exact Blind line is promised.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Wildling
roles.resolution: An empty travel result can hide astral movement. Sense is not an exact-role reveal or Spy-style effect log; public whispers you hear are separate from the nightly travel report.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Covenite
roles.resolution: Without the book, a quiet night is normal and creates no Covenite action result. With the book, distinguish an attack attempt from an actual death.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Cultist
roles.resolution: A button selection is not a confirmed conversion. Check the joined faction/team state; Indoctrinate preserves the target’s role and abilities. A book attack is a different action.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Baker
roles.resolution: Starting Bread is not a new Feed. A failed Feed adds no new recipient. Bread is not protection, and transformation/deaths must be separated from earlier feeding visits.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Berserker
roles.resolution: Early restricted nights or a held attack do not produce kills. Track actual kills and rampage victims separately; transformation needs the real threshold, not merely selected targets.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Plaguebearer
roles.resolution: Starting infection and an already infected contact are not new spread. A prevented direct Infect adds no new target; distinguish it from spread through contacts already infected.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Soul Collector
roles.resolution: A quiet Reap is not a kill. A soul can come from the role’s permitted passive/death conditions; do not claim every Reap immediately awards one or gives a Town result.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Doomsayer
roles.resolution: A failed set means at least one guess is wrong; it does not identify which. Do not replace a failure with three negative role checks. Doom is not defeated by an ordinary roleblock/control story.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Executioner
roles.resolution: A non-trial target death changes you into Jester privately. It is not an Executioner win or a public Jester revenge event; update the role and its later requirements.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Jester
roles.resolution: Missing Chatterbox can invalidate revenge even after hanging. A night death is not the qualifying win; a Haunt requires the actual revenge state, not a fabricated visitor result.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Pirate
roles.resolution: Scour is a Landlubber check; Plunder is a separate attack. A failed attack is not a negative Scour, and a Landlubber dying to another cause can still advance the objective. No old duels.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Arsonist
roles.resolution: A quiet Douse gives no Cleric save feedback. Clean stays home; Ignite is astral. Being Doused by another Arsonist and passive Dousing visitors are separate from a direct Douse destination.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Serial Killer
roles.resolution: Cautious changes roleblock retaliation, not your target’s identity. Attack feedback without a death can mean defense; an uncautious retaliatory death is not an ordinary selected-target kill.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Shroud
roles.resolution: A shrouded player staying home can redirect the outcome to an attack on that player. A shrouded visit is not proof of a willing attack; preserve mode and actual destination feedback.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Werewolf
roles.resolution: Non-Full Moon Scent is not an attack. Existing scents can still report when you are jailed. Staying home on a Full Moon can rampage at home; do not invent an outward visit.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Cursed Soul
roles.resolution: A failed or redirected Soul Swap does not prove the chosen player changed roles. Roles swap while factions remain; check the resulting role card instead of assigning a new allegiance.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Vampire
roles.resolution: An ineligible/defended Convert switches to Drain; during Grace Period that fallback can fail altogether. A surviving target is not confirmed conversion, and conversion preserves their role.
roles.wordingCoverage: paraphrased meaning; no exact role-specific quote verified

roles.name: Famine
roles.resolution: Starve reduces Bread; it is not a protective visit or ordinary attack. No immediate death does not prove Starve failed. The famine countdown is separate from your selected nightly target.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: War
roles.resolution: Quiet or survived targets do not justify reverting to Berserker’s old limits. War is roleblock/obstacle-immune and can select two houses; Witch redirects only the first visit.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Pestilence
roles.resolution: Pestilence stacks are not ordinary attacks. A failed-looking survival can mean the lethal threshold was not reached. Roleblock, jail and obstacles do not stop its immune/passive effects.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

roles.name: Death
roles.resolution: There is no normal night action/result to invent. The decisive condition is surviving the daytime execution deadline; ordinary roleblock or control does not cancel Armageddon.
roles.wordingCoverage: source-attested excerpts plus paraphrased meaning

sourceComparison: All 60 retrieved role-page texts matched the reviewed 2026-10-15 baseline.
